title: Renewal that does not say what happened to the handrails
why: 45 mm fails unless the handrails were kept, and the spec does not say.

spec.name: Renewal that does not say what happened to the handrails

handrails.outside_diameter_mm.required: 30–40 mm, unless the handrails are not renewed
handrails.outside_diameter_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.9(1) fails (45 > 40); Appendix F exempts handrails that are not renewed, and handrails_renewed is not supplied.
